message.content:
Based on the screenshot provided, here is the precise description of the desktop application interface:

**(1) Modal/Banner Overlay**
There is a central modal overlay titled **"Sign in to get started"**. The body text reads **"Sign in to start using Codex."**. It contains four buttons:
*   **"Sign in with ChatGPT"**
*   **"Use device code"** (This button has a small 'x' icon on its right edge)
*   **"Use API key"**
*   **"Use Amazon Bedrock (Experimental)"**

**(2) Left Sidebar Content**
Under the **"Projects"** heading, the text reads **"No projects"**.
Under the **"Chats"** heading (which has a search icon and a refresh icon to its right), the text reads **"No chats"**.

**(3) Bottom-Left Footer Status Text**
The status text at the very bottom left is: **"App-server online"** (preceded by a green dot icon).

**(4) Composer/Input Area State**
The input area at the bottom contains the placeholder text: **"Ask Codex to change, inspect, or explain..."**.
Below the input field, there are controls:
*   A dropdown menu displaying **"Ask for approval"**.
*   A model selector displaying **"GPT-5.6-Sol"**.
*   A setting selector displaying **"Low"**.
*   A mode selector displaying **"Standard"**.
*   A circular submit button with an upward arrow icon.

**(5) Status Bar Message Text**
The main content area behind the modal displays the header text **"What should we work on?"** and the subtext **"Start a new chat or open one from the sidebar."**.
